battle.name: 義土戰爭
battle.brief: 義土戰爭於1911年9月由義大利王國向鄂圖曼帝國宣戰而爆發，主要戰事發生於利比亞的黎波里塔尼亞與昔蘭尼加。義軍投入近代步兵、砲兵及騎兵，並以沿海據點與後勤航線支撐進攻；加特林機槍（Gatling gun）早在1860年已列裝，可提供持續的直射火力。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 加特林機槍自1860年起列入美國陸軍裝備，作為固定式重機槍部署於港口、要塞及野戰陣地，以高速連射提供遠程火力壓制。

countries: 題名中的1911指宣戰年份，戰鬥延續至1912年。這場戰爭通常稱為第一次義土戰爭或義大利－土耳其戰爭，交戰國為義大利王國與奧斯曼帝國，主要陸戰區域是北非的黎波里塔尼亞與昔蘭尼加，地中海上的愛琴海與突尼斯海峽則構成另一條戰線。義方以原已駐紮利比亞的陸軍為先導，後續部隊由義大利本土、馬耳他及西西里方向海運增援；土方依靠的黎波里與班加西的駐軍，以及由君士坦丁堡和埃及方向送來的援軍應戰。英屬埃及與法屬突尼斯不是交戰國，卻分別限制土軍的陸地補給、海上接應與義軍越境行動。義大利海艦隊控制了通往的黎波里、班加西及愛琴海島嶼的航線，使這場戰爭從開始便具有封鎖、登陸和遠距離補給的特徵。
countriesEn: The year 1911 in the title identifies the year of declaration, although the fighting continued into 1912. The conflict is generally known as the First Italo-Turkish War or the Italian-Turkish War, fought between the Kingdom of Italy and the Ottoman Empire. Its principal land theaters were Tripolitania and Cyrenaica in North Africa, while the Aegean and the Tunisian Channel formed a separate maritime axis. The Italian army was initially based in Libya and was reinforced by sea from Italy, Malta, and Sicily. The Ottomans relied on their garrisons at Tripoli and Benghazi together with reinforcements sent from Constantinople and Egypt. British Egypt and French Tunisia were not belligerents, but they restricted Ottoman land supply, maritime reinforcement, and Italian cross-border movement. The Italian navy controlled the sea routes to Tripoli, Benghazi, and the Aegean islands, giving the war a character shaped from the outset by blockade, amphibious movement, and long-distance supply.
people: 義方最高指揮官卡洛·卡內瓦以少量步兵、砲兵、工兵和後勤人員組成先遣指揮部，統籌的黎波里塔尼亞方面；亞歷山德羅·布里科拉負責昔蘭尼加方向，喬瓦尼·阿梅利奧指揮最初的登陸與橋頭堡作戰，並在中路擔任重要角色。海軍方面，西蒙內·帕科雷·德·聖邦率領包括裝甲巡洋艦Giuseppe Garibaldi與Francesco Crispi在內的攻擊分隊，執行的黎波里砲擊。土方指揮權數度重組：哈利爾帕夏奉派赴利比亞整頓軍政，恩韋爾帕夏以參謀身分重編守軍，後成為奧軍在利比亞的主要指揮者；卡維德帕夏其後接掌總督府與軍務，馬哈茂德·謝夫凱特帕夏於1911年12月到達的黎波里塔尼亞主持更高層級的作戰，艾哈邁德·穆赫塔爾帕夏則率領增援及野戰主力。這些將領的到任、輪替與指揮關係變化，直接造成各階段攻勢時緊時鬆。
peopleEn: General Carlo Caneva formed the Italian advanced command from a relatively small force of infantry, artillery, engineers, and logistics personnel and directed operations in Tripolitania. Alessandro Briccola handled the Cyrenaican front, while Giovanni Ameglio commanded the initial landings and bridgehead operations and later held a central role. At sea, Simone Pacoret de Saint-Bon led the force that included the armored cruisers Giuseppe Garibaldi and Francesco Crispi during the bombardment of Tripoli. Ottoman command was repeatedly reorganized. Halil Pasha was sent to inspect and restore the administration and military system; Enver Pasha reorganized the defenders in a staff capacity and became one of the principal Ottoman commanders in Libya; Cavit Pasha later assumed responsibility for the governor's office and military administration; Mahmud Shevket Pasha arrived in Tripolitania in December 1911 to direct operations at army level; and Ahmed Muhtar Pasha led the reinforcements and main field formations. Their arrivals, rotations, and changes in authority directly affected the uneven rhythm of the offensives.
kits: 義軍步兵以6.5×54mmR卡爾卡諾M91步槍為主要步槍，軍官與後勤人員使用Bodeo M1889左輪手槍及卡爾卡諾M91卡槍；快速部隊由乘自行車的bersaglieri射擊隊、騎兵與工兵協同。義軍的主要野戰砲包括FIAT 65/27 Modello 1905野戰砲與87/27口徑野戰砲，通用機槍則為8公厘FIAT-Revelli Modello 1904。航空方面，使用已在1911年投入軍用的SIA 7B與Macchi M.5執行偵察、照像及有限的轟炸任務，海上則有裝甲巡洋艦Giuseppe Garibaldi、Francesco Crispi及一批驅逐艦、潛艇與飛艇。土軍的步槍包括老舊的Martini-Henry M1871及M1888與Mauser M1888，並部署Maxim重機槍、105公厘Birmingham短身後膛野戰砲等火砲，後者因適於駱駝運輸而通稱camel gun。奧斯曼地中海分隊則包括裝甲戰艦Barbaros Hayreddin、Turgut Reis與護衛巡洋艦Mecidiye，顯示雙方在步兵火力以外，都依靠艦砲、機槍和不同口徑的野戰砲支援。
kitsEn: The principal Italian infantry rifle was the 6.5×54mmR Carcano M1915's predecessor, the Carcano M91, while officers and logistics personnel carried the Bodeo M1889 revolver and the Carcano M91 carbine. Mobile troops included bicycle-mounted bersaglieri, cavalry, and engineers. The main Italian field artillery consisted of the FIAT 65/27 Modello 1905 field gun and 87/27-caliber field guns, with the 8mm FIAT-Revelli Modello 1904 serving as the standard machine gun. SIA 7B and Macchi M.5 aircraft, already in military service by 1911, performed reconnaissance, photography, and limited bombing, while the navy fielded the armored cruisers Giuseppe Garibaldi and Francesco Crispi together with destroyers, submarines, and airships. Ottoman infantry used the older Martini-Henry M1871 and M1888 rifles as well as the Mauser M1888, supported by Maxim heavy machine guns and artillery that included the 105mm Birmingham short-barrel breech-loading field howitzer, commonly called the camel gun because it suited transport by camel. The Ottoman Mediterranean force also included the armored ships Barbaros Hayreddin and Turgut Reis and the protected cruiser Mecidiye, showing that both sides relied on naval guns, machine guns, and field artillery in addition to infantry fire.
tactics: 開戰後，義軍先沿的黎波里東側海岸道路向Shar al-Shatt推進，但最初的步兵攻勢受到土軍正面射擊與機槍火力阻擋，砲兵抵近後才迫使守軍退向內陸。另一支由布里科拉率領的縱隊則較快進入班加西。義方接著以海軍封鎖和艦砲支援港口攻堅：Paquare de Saint-Bon所部的炮火命中並引發的黎波里堡壘內的彈藥爆炸，守軍失去陣地，義軍才占領港口與要塞區。占領港口不等於控制全省，義軍仍以分隊沿有限道路推進，步兵由野戰砲掩護，工兵架橋與修路，騎兵和Arab及Berber武裝戰士負責偵察、襲擊側翼及破壞孤立土軍聯絡線。土軍避免在港口與義軍主力硬拼，選擇Homs、Bir el-Gasr、Qasr Abu Hadi一線實行延遲抵抗，並於1911年10月26日以Sidi Gaber反擊迫使義軍後退。冬季降雨、道路泥濘與補給線過長使戰局停滯；義軍改以海軍封鎖、空中觀察、砲兵驅逐和夜間小股襲擊削弱土軍。1912年春，義軍集中新增步兵與砲兵，逐個奪取Homs、Shar al-Shatt及Qasr Abu Hadi等據點，再以連續攻勢切斷的黎波里塔尼亞與昔蘭尼加之間的土軍聯絡。
tacticsEn: After war was declared, the Italians advanced along the road east of Tripoli toward Shar al-Shatt, but the initial infantry attack was checked by Ottoman rifle and machine-gun fire. Field artillery had to move close before the defenders withdrew inland. A separate column under Briccola entered Benghazi with comparatively little delay. The Italians then combined naval blockade with gunfire in attacks on the coastal defenses: the bombardment directed by Pacoret de Saint-Bon struck the Tripoli fortifications and set off explosions among the defenders' magazines, after which the garrison lost its positions and the Italians occupied the port and fortress district. Seizure of the ports did not equal control of the interior. Italian detachments continued to move along the limited roads, with infantry covered by field artillery, engineers bridging gaps and repairing routes, and cavalry and Arab and Berber armed fighters conducting reconnaissance, striking flanks, and disrupting isolated Ottoman communications. The Ottomans avoided a direct struggle with the main Italian force at the ports and adopted a delaying defense along Homs, Bir el-Gasr, and Qasr Abu Hadi. Their counterattack at Sidi Gaber on 26 October 1911 forced the Italians back. Winter rain, muddy roads, and overstretched supply routes then produced a deadlock, during which the Italians used blockade, aerial observation, artillery fire, and small nocturnal raids to wear down the Ottoman force. In the spring of 1912, fresh Italian infantry and artillery were concentrated for a series of attacks on Homs, Shar al-Shatt, and Qasr Abu Hadi, severing Ottoman communications between Tripolitania and Cyrenaica.
data: 時間線可由幾個明確節點校正。1911年9月23日義大利宣戰並在Shar al-Shatt交火；9月24日義軍占領班加西。10月5日義軍開始以艦砲轟擊的黎波里，堡壘在隨後數日陷落，港口落入義軍控制；10月26日土軍在Sidi Gaber反擊獲勝。11月底至12月初，義軍在Homs、Bir el-Gasr及Qasr Abu Hadi一線取得進展，其中Qasr Abu Hadi於12月6日被義軍占領。入冬後雙方沿內陸據點和道路網作長距離對峙。1912年2月開始的春季攻勢先取Homs，再奪Shar al-Shatt，至5月Qasr Abu Hadi與Sidi Gaber一帶的土軍野戰主力被擊破，的黎波里塔尼亞方面投降；10月昔蘭尼加的土軍完成撤退，10月29日簽訂拉奇條約或稱烏奇條約。後勤方面，義軍以汽船從義大利本土經馬耳他把步槍彈、砲彈、糧食、燃料及工程器材送至的黎波里、班加西與米蘇拉塔，再用汽車、馬車和駱駝隊送往前線。的黎波里至米蘇拉塔的鐵路在戰爭初期仍在施工，不能取代獸力運輸；炮彈雖能集中到港口與兵站，前沿小分隊仍常受彈藥、水和飼料限制。土軍則面臨港口遭封鎖、Martini-Henry與Mauser步槍採用不同口徑，以及砲兵燃料與駱駝運輸能力不足等問題。
dataEn: Several dated points establish the sequence of the campaign. Italy declared war and fought at Shar al-Shatt on 23 September 1911, and the Italians occupied Benghazi on 24 September. Naval bombardment of Tripoli began on 5 October; the fortifications fell within the following days, giving the Italians control of the port. The Ottomans counterattacked successfully at Sidi Gaber on 26 October. Between late November and early December, the Italians made progress along the Homs, Bir el-Gasr, and Qasr Abu Hadi line, capturing Qasr Abu Hadi on 6 December. Winter then produced a prolonged struggle between inland strongpoints and the road network. The Italian spring offensive began in February 1912, took Homs, and then captured Shar al-Shatt. Ottoman field forces in the Qasr Abu Hadi and Sidi Gaber sector were broken in May, leading to the surrender of the Tripolitania force. The Ottoman withdrawal from Cyrenaica was completed in October, and the Treaty of Ouchy, also called the First Treaty of Lausanne, was signed on 29 October. Logistically, Italian steamers carried rifle ammunition, artillery shells, food, fuel, and engineering equipment from Italy through Malta to Tripoli, Benghazi, and Misrata. Motor vehicles, wagons, and camel teams then moved supplies toward the front. The Tripoli-Misrata railway was still under construction early in the war and could not replace animal transport. Although shells could be concentrated at the ports and depots, isolated detachments often suffered from shortages of ammunition, water, and animal fodder. The Ottomans faced the blockade of their ports, the different calibers and magazines of the Martini-Henry and Mauser rifles, and persistent shortages of artillery fuel and camel transport.
cause: 義土戰爭的直接背景是義大利在1910至1911年間鞏固的黎波里塔尼亞與昔蘭尼加殖民統治，並準備把奧斯曼帝國在北非的殘餘軍事存在逐出。1911年夏季，Arab與Berber武裝組織在利比亞各地起義，削弱了當地奧軍守備；同年青年土耳其人革命又使君士坦丁堡的中央政權陷入重組。義大利把這些變化視為有利時機，試圖以軍事行動取得對利比亞的完整控制。義土外交談判與的黎波里的政治摩擦持續惡化，法國在突尼斯邊境及英國在埃及的部署又使義方擔心任何干預會迫使行動延期。義大利最終在外交準備和海陸調度完成後提出要求，於9月23日單方面宣戰。土方沒有足夠兵力保衛廣大的內陸地區，只能一面維持港口與主要道路，一面從本土和埃及方向尋求增援。
causeEn: The immediate background was Italy's consolidation of its colonial administration in Tripolitania and Cyrenaica during 1910 and 1911, together with its intention to remove the remaining Ottoman military presence in North Africa. Arab and Berber armed organizations rose across Libya during the summer of 1911, weakening the Ottoman garrison, while the Young Turk Revolution in Constantinople disrupted the central government. Italy judged that these conditions created a favorable opportunity to secure complete control of Libya. Its diplomatic exchanges with the Ottoman government deteriorated amid political friction in Tripoli, while French deployments along the Tunisian frontier and British positions in Egypt raised the fear that intervention might delay Italian action. Once diplomatic preparations and naval and troop movements were complete, Italy presented its demands and declared war unilaterally on 23 September. The Ottoman government lacked the troops to defend the vast interior and therefore attempted to hold the ports and principal roads while seeking reinforcements from the metropole and Egypt.
impact: 這場戰爭首先改變了北非的軍事地圖。義大利獲得的黎波里、班加西與米蘇拉塔等港口，便於把沿海控制轉化為向內陸推進的基地；英屬埃及與法屬突尼斯之間的北非戰略格局，也因義大利取得利比亞而改變。軍事技術方面，艦艇封鎖、艦砲攻堅、飛艇與航空偵察，以及由港口集中供應多兵種部隊的做法，都得到實際運用。義大利雖取得廣大領土，卻必須長期維持遠征軍、保護交通線並應付新一輪武裝抵抗，塞努西戰事其後延續至1915至1917年；財政、海運與人力負擔也成為義大利政治與軍事擴張的限制。奧斯曼帝國則失去北非屬地，軍隊與財政被牽制，並在1912年面臨巴爾幹戰爭全面升高的同時承受利比亞潰敗，使原本已緊張的帝國處境更加困難。
impactEn: The war immediately altered the military geography of North Africa. With Tripoli, Benghazi, and Misrata in Italian hands, control of the coast could be converted into bases for inland operations, while the strategic position between British Egypt and French Tunisia changed with Italy's acquisition of Libya. In military terms, the campaign demonstrated the practical use of naval blockade, shipboard gunfire, airships, aerial reconnaissance, and the concentration of several arms in ports supplied by sea. Italy gained extensive territory but still had to maintain a distant army, protect its communications, and face renewed armed resistance, including the Senussi campaigns that continued from 1915 to 1917. The financial, shipping, and manpower burden also constrained Italy's wider military and political expansion. The Ottoman Empire lost its North African possession, had its forces and finances tied down, and suffered the collapse in Libya at the same time that the Balkan wars escalated in 1912, worsening an already fragile imperial position.
result: 結果是義大利取得決定性勝利，而奧斯曼帝國失去在利比亞的實際統治。1912年5月，的黎波里塔尼亞的土軍野戰主力在Qasr Abu Hadi與Sidi Gaber一連串失利後投降，殘餘部隊向東撤退；昔蘭尼加守軍於10月撤離，10月29日的烏奇條約承認義大利對的黎波里塔尼亞與昔蘭尼加的主權，義大利則停止對奧斯曼其他領土提出新的要求。義方保留對愛琴海諸島的控制，後於1915年正式將其併入版圖。從作戰層面看，決定性因素是義軍先取得港口，再利用封鎖、砲兵、步兵與後勤形成連續攻勢，而不是單一一場會戰；土軍雖以Sidi Gaber反擊和內陸延遲防線挽回部分時間，仍未能恢復可持續的戰區縱深。戰爭結束了奧斯曼在利比亞的正式權力，但沒有終止當地持續的武裝抵抗，也沒有使義大利立刻完成對新領土的全面整合。
resultEn: The result was a decisive Italian victory and the loss of Ottoman effective control over Libya. In May 1912, after successive defeats around Qasr Abu Hadi and Sidi Gaber, the Ottoman field army in Tripolitania surrendered and the remaining forces withdrew eastward. The Cyrenaican garrison was evacuated in October, and the Treaty of Ouchy on 29 October recognized Italian sovereignty over Tripolitania and Cyrenaica, while Italy abandoned further claims against Ottoman territory. Italy retained control of the Aegean islands and formally incorporated them in 1915. At the operational level, the decisive factors were the Italian seizure of the ports and the subsequent combination of blockade, artillery, infantry, and logistics into a continuous offensive, rather than any single battlefield decision. The Ottoman counterattack at Sidi Gaber and the delaying defense in the interior recovered some time, but they could not restore a sustainable depth of operations. The war ended Ottoman authority in Libya, although it did not end continued armed resistance there or immediately produce a complete Italian integration of the new territory.
